scripts.build: sh -ec 'echo "Selecting artifact from latest commit..."; FILE=$(git diff-tree --no-commit-id --name-only -r HEAD | grep "^iflows/.*\.zip$" | tail -1); test -n "$FILE"; test -f "$FILE"; BASENAME=$(basename "$FILE"); echo "Git commit: $(git rev-parse HEAD)"; echo "Processing $FILE"; unzip -t "$FILE"; mkdir -p dist; cp "$FILE" "dist/$BASENAME"; NEXUS_USER="admin"; test -n "$nexus_password"; test -n "$ARTIFACT_URL"; echo "Uploading to Nexus..."; curl --fail --show-error --silent -u "$NEXUS_USER:$nexus_password" -T "dist/$BASENAME" "$ARTIFACT_URL/$BASENAME"; echo "Uploaded successfully"'
